title: Restoring a deleted campaign works for much larger campaigns
summary: Restoring a shared campaign's recovery copy, and saving campaigns with long histories, now need far less server memory.
items: Restore from a deletion recovery copy handles archived sessions one at a time, so campaigns with many archived sessions restore reliably.
Saving a shared campaign whose whole history is open no longer copies that history several times on the server. What is stored is exactly the same as before.
